comment: Mutations taken from builds that really shipped, kept as the gate's regression fixture.
Each one left the whole test suite green at the commit it shipped in, and each was
found by an expensive review pass rather than by anything in the build. They are here
so a change to the harness has to keep answering SURVIVED where a mutation really was
unpinned and KILLED where it really is pinned — a harness that only ever says one of
those is broken in the direction that matters, and a fixture set with only one answer
in a checkout of the commit that <name> refers to. Not part of CI: it needs three
checkouts and a full build of each, which is the wrong cost to pay on every pull
request. The commits are kept reachable by the tags mutation-fixture-round-7 and
ABSENT is a recorded answer, not a gap. Round 7's two mutations delete a directory
presence check that round 8 replaced outright with a kind carried from the
declaration, so at round 8 and after there is no such check to delete. The harness
proves the anchor is gone rather than passing in silence.

refs.round-7: 58ddb95 — the directory question answered by asking the filesystem
refs.round-8: 19857ca — the kind carried from the declaration
refs.main: 8b6353d — the merged result, where round 9 added the pins

fixtures.what: Delete the directory skip in the missing-artifact report: a real, correctly created directory is then counted as an artifact the step failed to produce.
Delete the directory skip in the artifact hash: fs::read on a directory errors, the hash is None, and the step re-runs on every run while reporting it produced nothing.
Reduce the directory hash to a manifest of filenames: a partition file whose BYTES change under an unchanged set of paths reads as unchanged, and the step skips at exit 0.
Stop descending into subdirectories: a real PARTITION_BY tree has no regular file at its top level, so the whole tree hashes to the same empty manifest forever.
Let the last declaration win instead of the first: a hand-written produces: entry downgrades the kind SQL introspection derived, and a directory is read as a file.

Fold an unreadable directory into a stable value instead of propagating None: the baseline recorded after the step's own success already says the placeholder, so every later run compares it to itself and skips.
Read every file in the tree as empty: the content half of the directory hash goes away by a second route, and an unreadable child file stops forcing staleness.
